acceptance_criteria.then: the API returns 201 with code, short_url and created_at
the service redirects with 302 to the stored target and Cache-Control no-store
the service returns 404 using the error envelope

acceptance_criteria.given: a javascript:, private-network or malformed URL
acceptance_criteria.when: a client tries to shorten it

acceptance_criteria.given: the same Idempotency-Key and body sent twice
acceptance_criteria.then: exactly one link exists and the second response is a replay
they report liveness and database readiness

acceptance_criteria.when: it is upgraded, downgraded and upgraded again

constraints: Python 3.11+, FastAPI, Pydantic v2, SQLAlchemy 2.0 async, Alembic; SQLite by default, Postgres supported.
No secrets in code; configuration via environment variables.
functional: Create short links via POST /api/v1/links with optional custom alias and tags; support Idempotency-Key.
Redirect GET /{code} to the target URL (302 by default, 307 configurable); 404 for unknown codes, 410 for disabled or deleted links.
Read link metadata via GET /api/v1/links/{code}; disable via PATCH; soft delete via DELETE.
Liveness (GET /healthz) and readiness (GET /readyz, checks the database) probes.
Persist links in a relational database managed by reversible migrations.
content.goal: Build a URL shortener with create, redirect, metadata and health endpoints, persistence and tests.
non_functional: Codes are 7 random base62 characters with collision retry; capacity and collision math documented.
Only http/https targets; reject javascript:/data:/file:, embedded credentials, private and loopback hosts; max length 2048.
Structured JSON logs with request ids; consistent error envelope {"error":{code,message,request_id}}.
Security headers and request body size limits.
